limitations: All orders in tests are isolated fictional fixtures; production Firebase boot is removed and external browser requests are blocked.
No physical iPhone keyboard, IME, or hardware was tested.
Cloud emulator and native audio suites were not rerun and are not included.
Hub/multi/workflow reports embed startup source hashes; layout reports label their post-run verification hashes explicitly.
preserved: 129 product IDs, primary names, translations, original product order and supplier grouping
Separate stock and order quantities/units, including saved historical units
Login, account permissions, shared save, finalization, reopening and supplier export rules
Existing count search and multi-item search matching
